scope: Independent data completeness and exact statistical reconstruction for four frozen stage-3/4 windows and stage-4 mixed controls; no benchmark rerun, product gate or broad Rust-parity acceptance
stage3_equivalence: 5e changes tests/design only relative to a4; production equality previously verified in stage3-test-binding.json
statistical_rule: Use manifest blocks (5 or 10), complete ABBA/BAAB schedule, per-cell/per-block/per-arm arithmetic means, median of these block means (average middle two at 10 blocks), then candidate/baseline ratio. Session private includes five consecutive edits per run, ten observations per block/arm. Exact Fraction arithmetic; comparison tolerance only final floating serialization. Observed p95 and RSS medians recomputed as frozen protocol.
native_cache_control: All CLI LLVM API builds: actual=requested units 8, jobs 2; cold hits/misses 0/8, unchanged/restore 8/0, each private edit 7/1. All raw codegen verification receipts checked. Native stdout matches generated sum+edit.
cpu_diagnostic: Every stage-4 Session transcript includes positive integer process_cpu_ns; row equals raw transcript, physical sanity bound checked. Per-cell CPU block medians also reconstructed in stage4-evidence-recomputed.json. Includes compiler threads, excludes child linkers and native controls; not total build-tree CPU. Stage-3 has no CPU field.

probe_source_provenance.independent_check: Read current source and exact 9fe Git blobs; hashes match. Read three preserved measured ELFs and three /tmp reproduced ELFs; each hash matches its counterpart and every relevant measurement manifest. No benchmark rerun.

constructor_test_log.note: Zero-test targets contribute zero, not a separate pass.

prior_current_source_test_review: stage4-review.json records exact final 10 reviewer tests plus constructor 495 log chronology and all-target lint/fmt limitations. No further tests run in this statistical review.

document_review.note: All cells/printed precision and main report counts and caveats checked. 9.953ms explicitly identifies 20-request raw event median; 10.045ms identifies median block means. Original stage-2 RESULTS/MEASUREMENTS hashes unchanged.

limitations: Session per-request Verify=1 and native success are asserted by the hash-bound probe before emitting each row; full CompileReport and native stdout are not separately persisted for those requests. Raw phase records independently show one Verify execution.
CLI build records retain all native stdout and per-request ELF hashes; each run overwrites the executable, so only the final restore ELF per run remains for present-day hash verification.
All four windows have separate candidate CLI files preserved for current hash checks. Source/binary build provenance is separate from this statistical reconstruction.
Stage-4 process_cpu_ns includes compiler threads and excludes child linkers/native controls; it is diagnostic and not whole-build-tree CPU. Stage-3 has no such field.
CLI ru_maxrss is child high-water RSS; Session VmRSS is a post-request sample. They are different metrics and cannot be combined into a peak-memory claim.
Phase fields are time between observer events, including intervening driver work; they are not exclusive phase CPU cost.
Session private pools five consecutive edits per arm/run. Each block/arm mean has ten private samples versus two for other request labels.
Rust reference is direct rustc O0/metadata with its stated incremental/CGU flags, not Cargo or full language/product parity.
No benchmark was rerun; all unfavorable cells are retained in the review.
Session native success and Verify count are probe assertions with phase evidence; no individual stdout/full report files are retained for those requests.
Retained mixed/Session ELFs and LL files are hashed in the inventory as current evidence identities; no retroactive run-time hash is invented where the original row has none.
All unfavorable wall and RSS cells are preserved, including stage3-isolation 512 private +13.457% and 32 warm build +2.742%. Across-window improvements must not be multiplied.
Current binary identities match all manifest hashes in these four windows; historical stage-2 overwritten-path limitations remain attached to stage-2 evidence, not silently rewritten here.
delivery_binding_scope: This receipt completes statistical/document/source-probe review of supplied frozen evidence. Outer archive MANIFEST and later exact delivery commit are separate subsequent delivery-identity checks; not asserted here.
